description: The string and Windows-path forms of a custom fileType, through the real CLI. Each test runs one case of dry-run-detect.cjs, which writes its files under .tmp/fixture-detection/ and checks the detected or run steps. No browser or network, so every case runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

tests.description: `extensions` as a string, without `extends`, matches by whole extension: `cjs` doesn't claim a `.js` file.
A runShell fileType's `$1` takes the file's absolute path, with forward slashes on Windows, and the command runs with `$1` quoted or unquoted.
A markup definition's `actions` as a string detects one step.
